blocks.title: Reported
blocks.text: Palo Alto Networks describes itself as a global AI cybersecurity provider; its platforms and services secure enterprise users, networks, clouds, endpoints, AI apps and agents, and identities.

evidence.quote: Our platforms and services help secure enterprise users, networks, clouds, endpoints, AI apps and agents, and identities

blocks.title: Reported
blocks.text: The company’s strategy includes integrating offerings into platforms to consolidate customers’ separate security products.

evidence.quote: A key element of our strategy is to help our customers simplify their security architectures through consolidating disparate point products.

blocks.title: Reported
blocks.text: Customer support and professional services complement product and subscription offerings; customers typically purchase support for one year or longer and typically renew for successive one-year or longer periods.

evidence.quote: End-customers typically purchase these services for a one-year or longer term at the time of the initial product sale and typically renew for successive one-year or longer periods.

cells: Network & AI Security
SASE, next-generation firewalls, and cloud-delivered security services for users, branches, data, applications, devices, and connections.

evidence.quote: Through these add-on services, our customers are able to secure their content, applications, users, devices, and connection across their entire organization.

cells: Prisma AIRS
Discover, assess, and protect AI agents, applications, models, and data across the AI lifecycle.

evidence.quote: designed to help organizations discover, assess, and protect AI agents, applications, models and data across the AI lifecycle.

cells: Cortex Security Operations
Security operations capabilities including SIEM, endpoint security, automation, cloud detection and response, and attack surface management.

evidence.quote: unifies standalone Security Information and Event Management (“SIEM”) tools, endpoint security, security automation, cloud detection and response (“CDR”), as well as attack surface management (“ASM”) capabilities

cells: Cortex Cloud
Cloud application security across development and operations in multi- and hybrid-cloud environments.

evidence.quote: Cortex Cloud secures multi- and hybrid-cloud environments for applications, data, generative AI (“GenAI”) ecosystem, and the cloud native technology stack across the full development lifecycle

cells: Chronosphere
Observability and monitoring across cloud-native infrastructure, applications, and AI workloads.

evidence.quote: delivers real-time visibility and monitoring across cloud-native infrastructure, applications, and AI workloads.

cells: Idira
Identity security for human, agentic, and machine identities, including identity access management, privileged access management, and identity governance.

evidence.quote: By unifying identity access management, privilege access management, and identity governance and administration

cells: Unit 42
Threat intelligence, incident response, security consulting, and managed detection and response services.

evidence.quote: Additionally, Unit 42 offers managed detection and response (“MDR”) and managed threat hunting services.

cells: Reported demand signal
The CEO described customers as turning to the company to secure AI deployments at scale.

evidence.quote: customers turn to us to secure their AI deployments at scale

cells: Reported management commentary
Management said advances at the AI frontier had increased cybersecurity urgency.

evidence.quote: increased the level of urgency around cybersecurity

cells: Inferred buyer archetype
Organizations managing campus, data-center, branch, or cloud networks may be buyers for network security offerings.

evidence.quote: Our ML-Powered Next-Generation Firewalls (“NGFWs”) secure on-premises environments including campus locations and data centers. Our software NGFWs secure virtual and cloud networks.

cells: Inferred buyer archetype
Organizations developing or operating applications in multi- or hybrid-cloud environments may be buyers for cloud security offerings.

evidence.quote: Cortex Cloud secures multi- and hybrid-cloud environments for applications

cells: Inferred buyer archetype
Organizations managing workforce, privileged, or machine identities may be buyers for identity security offerings.

evidence.quote: secure human, agentic, and machine identities across the enterprise

blocks.title: Reported facts (no named customer identities used)

cells: Channel support
Channel partners operating authorized support centers typically provide level-one and level-two support; the company provides level-three support around the clock through regional support centers.

evidence.quote: Our channel partners that operate a Palo Alto Networks Authorized Support Center typically deliver level-one and level-two support. We provide level-three support 24 hours a day, seven days a week

cells: Professional services delivery
Professional services are delivered primarily by the company and through a global network of authorized channel partners to end-customers.

evidence.quote: Professional services are primarily delivered directly by Palo Alto Networks and through a global network of authorized channel partners to our end-customers

cells: Support purchasers
Support is offered to end-customers and channel partners.

evidence.quote: We offer Standard Support, Premium Support, and Platinum Support to our end-customers and channel partners.
